scripts.check: npm run check:js && npm run validate:html && npm run check:spell
scripts.check:js: node --check js/main.js && node --check js/three-scene.js && node --check js/server-room-scene.js && node --check js/emblem-scene.js && node --check js/firebase-config.js && node --check js/admin.js && node --check functions/index.js
scripts.check:spell: npx --yes cspell index.html admin.html archives.html eduventure.html README.md js/*.js css/styles.css
scripts.validate:html: npx --yes html-validate index.html admin.html archives.html eduventure.html
scripts.deploy:functions: npm --prefix functions install && npx --yes firebase-tools deploy --project portfolio-9b8a5 --only functions --force
scripts.deploy:firebase: npm run deploy:firebase:rules && npm run deploy:functions
